scheme_name: Assistance for Delivery of a Child or the Miscarriage of Pregnancy or the Termination of Pregnancy
other_conditions: Applicant must have no dues payable to the board
Applicant must be giving birth to a child, or have a miscarriage, or have undergone termination of pregnancy
Applicant must not already have two children
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹6,000 for child delivery or ₹3,000 for miscarriage or termination, disbursed in monthly installments (₹1,000 per month for six months for delivery).
